findings.claim: Default root padding shifts SGR mouse coordinates away from the clicked content cell.
findings.evidence: Built WTerm plus committed core WASM: a click centered in default content cell 1,1 of an 824x424 padded root emitted ESC[<0;2;2M/m. Current xterm.js subtracts root padding before cell division.
findings.path: InputHandler.handleMouse -> WTerm.onData via root border-box coordinate scaling

findings.claim: Capture is bound to global window and a single boolean, losing valid iframe and multi-button releases and permitting an orphan release after an invalid press.
findings.evidence: Forced iframe owner-window mouseup emitted no release; left+right chord lost the second release after the first mouseup with buttons=1; zero-rect mousedown followed by valid-rect mouseup emitted release without press.

findings.claim: Required root, docs-app, and Ghostty package documentation remains missing.
findings.evidence: No root/apps-docs/Ghostty README file is in the diff; API reference ends its mode table at usingAltScreen and vanilla docs omit mouse/focus onData behavior. Corrected surfaces gate flags apps docs and root README.
findings.path: packages core/dom/ghostty source -> package docs, root features, docs app

findings.claim: The prior ordinary main-window outside-release bug remains.
findings.evidence: HEAD emits press, clamped outside drag, and outside release; reverting only input.ts to f2a4752 makes the capture test red.

findings.claim: Ghostty-backed WTerm still silently disables mouse/focus.
findings.evidence: Committed Ghostty WASM exports/readback and WTerm input drive pass; replacing only the binary with f2a4752 fails on missing mouse_tracking.

findings.claim: Scrollback rows still directly distort active viewport row mapping.
findings.evidence: HEAD maps against the visible root instead of the history-height grid and the prior forced cell passes; the separate padded-root inverse regression is P1-COORD-PADDING.

findings.claim: Middle/right drag and horizontal/zero wheel findings remain.
findings.evidence: HEAD matrix passes; reverting only input.ts to 0394c2f encodes both drags as left and horizontal/zero ticks as vertical-down, turning the guard red.

findings.claim: React and Vue source files need independent mouse/focus changes.
findings.evidence: Both wrappers pass through WTerm/TerminalCore and contain no separate input encoder; their tests and type-checks pass.
